title: 6 signs you're revenge scrolling
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 52 on a named concept (revenge bedtime procrastination): naming the habit gives the hook a word people search and repeat.
caption: the day was not yours so the night has to be #revengebedtimeprocrastination #sleep
check: closer: 'i was all 6'. Only if true for you

slides.heading: you stay up because _the day wasn't yours_
slides.text: so midnight feels like the _only time you own_

slides.heading: you know you're tired and _keep going_
slides.text:
tiredness isn't the signal anymore

_the feed ending_ is, and it never ends

slides.heading: you're _not even enjoying it_
slides.text: it's not fun. it's just _not over yet_

slides.heading: "just checking one thing"
slides.text:
the check is never the problem

the _next swipe_ is

slides.heading: the night only ends when _your phone does_
slides.top: so i made mine end first
slides.text:
my apps go _to sleep at 11_ now

the night is still mine. i just spend it _asleep_

slides.question: how many are you? 👇
lines: the app is locturne, it's on the App Store
